name: Adinazolam
summary: Benzodiazepine derivative that has some antidepressant properties. has been sold as a research chemical.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It possesses anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, sedative, and antidepressant properties.

uses.text: Adinazolam (marketed under the brand name Deracyn) is a tranquilizer of the triazolobenzodiazepine (TBZD) class, which are benzodiazepines (BZDs) fused with a triazole ring. Adinazolam was developed by Jackson B. Hester, who was seeking to enhance the antidepressant properties of alprazolam, which he also developed.

sideEffects.text: When using adinazolam, individuals may experience various side effects, both in the short- and long term. Initially, common side effects in the short term may include drowsiness, sedation, and mild cognitive impairment. Overdose may include muscle weakness, ataxia, dysarthria and particularly in children paradoxical excitement, as well as diminished reflexes, confusion and coma may ensue in more severe cases.

summaryZh: 阿地唑侖（英語：Adinazolam），商品名Deracyn，是三唑並苯二氮䓬類鎮靜劑，它是與三唑環融合的苯二氮䓬類。它具有抗焦慮、抗驚厥、鎮靜和抗抑鬱的特性。阿地唑侖由傑克遜·海絲特開發，他正在尋求增強阿普唑侖（也是他開發的）的抗抑鬱特性。阿地唑侖從未獲得FDA批准，也從未在公共市場上銷售，但它已作為設計師藥物出售。
summaryZhHans: 阿地唑仑（英语：Adinazolam），商品名Deracyn，是三唑并苯二氮䓬类镇静剂，它是与三唑环融合的苯二氮䓬类。它具有抗焦虑、抗惊厥、镇静和抗抑郁的特性。阿地唑仑由杰克逊·海丝特开发，他正在寻求增强阿普唑仑（也是他开发的）的抗抑郁特性。阿地唑仑从未获得FDA批准，也从未在公共市场上销售，但它已作为设计师药物出售。

fact.en: It is a triazolobenzodiazepine, the same subfamily as alprazolam, and the body breaks it down into N-desmethyladinazolam, which is more active than the drug given.
fact.zh: 它屬於三唑苯二氮平類，與阿普唑侖（alprazolam）同屬一個亞家族。身體會把它分解成N-去甲阿地唑侖，而這個產物的活性比原本服用的藥物更強。
fact.zhHans: 它属于三唑苯二氮平类，与阿普唑仑（alprazolam）同属一个亚家族。身体会把它分解成N-去甲阿地唑仑，而这个产物的活性比原本服用的药物更强。
